04. This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. This Transfer Petition has been filed by the Petitioner- Wife for transfer of proceeding in C.P.
Case No.29 of 2024 filed by the Opposite Party-Husband, now pending in the Court of Judge,
Family Court, Jharsuguda, to the Court of Civil Judge (Sr. Divn.), Chhatrapur for trial on the grounds detailed in the Transfer Petition.

entities.text:
Court of Judge,
Family Court, Jharsuguda
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Court of Civil Judge (Sr. Divn.), Chhatrapur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. Heard learned Counsel for the parties.
4. Learned Counsel for the Petitioner, reiterating the grounds urged in the Transfer Petition submits, the Petitioner is a housewife and after her desertion, she is staying with her parents at Chhatrapur and it would be difficult on her part to attend the proceeding at Jharsuguda in C.P. Case No.29 of 2024 preferred by the Opposite Party-husband for restitution of conjugal rights.

He further submits, at the instance of the Petitioner, G.R. Case No.1119/2023, arising out of P.S. Case No.556 dated 28.08.2023 for commission of offences under Section 323, 294, 342, 307, 498-A, 506, 420/34 I.P.C. read with Sections 4 and 6(v) of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961
is now pending before the S.D.J.M., Chhatrapur, wherein the Opposite Party-husband, being an accused person, has already appeared and has been released on bail.
He is to face the trial in G.R. Case No.1119/2023 at Chhatrapur.
Hence, prayer for transfer of C.P. Case No.29 of 2024 from the Court of Judge, Family Court, Jharsuguda, to the Court of Civil Judge (Sr. Divn.), Chhatrapur may kindly be allowed.

entities.text: Court of Judge, Family Court, Jharsuguda
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Court of Civil Judge (Sr. Divn.), Chhatrapur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
5. Though no written objection has been filed opposing to such prayer made in the Transfer Petition,
Namita Patra vs Priyabrata Nikhandia @ .... Opposite ... on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32833029/
1 per contra, learned Counsel for the Opposite Party-husband, drawing attention of this Court to the averments made in the Transfer Petition submits, in some of the paragraphs of the Transfer Petition, it has been mentioned that proceeding in C.P. Case No.29 of 2024 may be transferred from the Court of Judge, Family Court, Jharsuguda to the Court of Judge, Family Court, Berhampur.

If such a prayer is allowed with liberty to the Opposite Party-husband to appear through virtual mode,
he will have no objection to such prayer made by the Petitioner-wife.

He further submits, distance from Chhatrapur to Berhampur would be hardly around 20 K.Ms. and the Judge, Family Court,
Berhampur is competent Court to try C.P. Case No.29 of 2024, having a better video conferencing facilities.

Hence, the proceeding should be transferred to the Court of Judge, Family Court,
Berhampur, instead of the Court of Civil Judge (Sr. Divn.), Chhatrapur.

entities.text:
Court of Judge, Family Court,
Berhampur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
6. Hence, in view of the reasons detailed in the Transfer Petition so also taking note of the submissions made by learned Counsel for the parties, this Court is inclined to direct the Judge,
Family Court, Jharsuguda to transmit the case record in C.P. Case No.29 of 2024 to the Court of Judge, Family Court, Berhampur at the earliest, preferably within a period of seven days from the date of production of the certified copy of this order.

entities.text: Court of Judge, Family Court, Berhampur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
7. On receiving the case record in C.P. Case No.29 of 2024 from the Court of Judge, Family Court,
Jharsuguda, the Judge, Family Court, Berhampur shall re-register the said case, if so required, and proceed further in accordance with law giving due opportunity to both the parties and shall try to conclude the said proceeding at the earliest.

entities.text:
Court of Judge, Family Court,
Jharsuguda
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
8. It is made clear that parties will be at liberty to appear before the Judge, Family Court,
Berhampur through virtual mode.

The Judge, Family Court, Berhampur is requested to explore the facilities available in the said Court for video conferencing and proceed further following due procedure as prescribed under the Orissa High Court Video Conferencing for Courts Rules, 2020.

entities.text: Orissa High Court Video Conferencing for Courts Rules, 2020
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
However, on the dates of effective hearing i.e. for examination and cross-examination of witnesses,
for which their presence may be required by the Court, if it is so required and ordered, the parties shall remain physically present before the Judge, Family Court, Berhampur.

9. To avoid delay, the parties are directed not to ask for unnecessary adjournments and cooperate with the Judge, Family Court, Berhampur, who shall do well to conclude the said proceeding at the earliest, preferably within a period of six months from the date of receipt of the records from the Court of Judge, Family Court, Jharsuguda.
10. With the said observation and direction, the Transfer Petition stands disposed of.

11. Office is directed to communicate a copy of this order to the Judge, Family Court, Jharsuguda so also the Judge, Family Court, Berhampur enabling the said Courts to act in terms of the observations made above.
12. Interim order dated 15.04.2024 passed in I.A. No.78 of 2024 stands vacated.
13. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.

opennyai_summary.decision:
6. Hence, in view of the reasons detailed in the Transfer Petition so also taking note of the submissions made by learned Counsel for the parties, this Court is inclined to direct the Judge,
Family Court, Jharsuguda to transmit the case record in C.P. Case No.29 of 2024 to the Court of Judge, Family Court, Berhampur at the earliest, preferably within a period of seven days from the date of production of the certified copy of this order.
7. On receiving the case record in C.P. Case No.29 of 2024 from the Court of Judge, Family Court,
Jharsuguda, the Judge, Family Court, Berhampur shall re-register the said case, if so required, and proceed further in accordance with law giving due opportunity to both the parties and shall try to conclude the said proceeding at the earliest.
8. It is made clear that parties will be at liberty to appear before the Judge, Family Court,
Berhampur through virtual mode.
The Judge, Family Court, Berhampur is requested to explore the facilities available in the said Court for video conferencing and proceed further following due procedure as prescribed under the Orissa High Court Video Conferencing for Courts Rules, 2020.
However, on the dates of effective hearing i.e. for examination and cross-examination of witnesses,
for which their presence may be required by the Court, if it is so required and ordered, the parties shall remain physically present before the Judge, Family Court, Berhampur.
9. To avoid delay, the parties are directed not to ask for unnecessary adjournments and cooperate with the Judge, Family Court, Berhampur, who shall do well to conclude the said proceeding at the earliest, preferably within a period of six months from the date of receipt of the records from the Court of Judge, Family Court, Jharsuguda.
10. With the said observation and direction, the Transfer Petition stands disposed of.
11. Office is directed to communicate a copy of this order to the Judge, Family Court, Jharsuguda so also the Judge, Family Court, Berhampur enabling the said Courts to act in terms of the observations made above.
13. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
